question: How much is the referral bonus for referring an instructor who gets hired?
expected_answer: CNY 3,000, paid with payroll after the referred employee completes 90 days (HR-REC-001 v2.1).

question: How long is a job offer valid?
expected_answer: 7 calendar days.

question: How long is the probation period for an instructor, and for a manager?
expected_answer: 3 months for instructors and non-management staff; 6 months for managers (M1 and above).

question: How much does the company pay for an external certification?
expected_answer: 80 percent of the fee, up to CNY 5,000 per calendar year, with prior manager approval and a 12-month service commitment.

question: When do promotion panels meet?
expected_answer: Twice a year, in April and October; applications are due 4 weeks before.

question: How many days of annual leave does an employee with 6 years of service get?
expected_answer: 10 days.

question: How far in advance must an instructor request leave on a day with scheduled classes?
expected_answer: At least 14 days, and a qualified substitute must be proposed and confirmed by the department head.

question: What is the standard weekly teaching load for instructors and what is the maximum?
expected_answer: 16 teaching hours per week standard; 24 hours is the maximum.

question: On which day is salary paid, and what happens if it is a weekend?
expected_answer: On the 10th of each month; if the 10th is a weekend or public holiday, on the last business day before the 10th.

question: What are the performance rating categories and their target shares?
What happens after two consecutive C ratings?
expected_answer: A 60-day performance improvement plan (PIP).

question: Who approves an expense claim of CNY 4,500?
expected_answer: The Campus Director (claims of 1,001 to 10,000).

question: Within how many days must an expense claim be submitted?
expected_answer: Within 30 calendar days of the expense date; later claims need Finance Manager approval and claims older than 90 days are rejected.

question: What is the hotel limit per night in Shenzhen, and in Xi'an?
expected_answer: CNY 600 in Shenzhen (Tier 1) and CNY 450 in Xi'an (Tier 2).

question: How much is the meal allowance on a business trip?
expected_answer: CNY 100 per full travel day, in all cities.

question: What are the rules for booking flights?
expected_answer: Economy class, booked at least 7 days in advance; later bookings need Campus Director approval.

question: What is the limit for client entertainment meals?
expected_answer: CNY 300 per person per meal, with advance written approval of the Campus Director; alcohol is not reimbursable.

question: How much can an instructor spend on teaching supplies without pre-approval?
expected_answer: Up to CNY 500 per class group per month.

question: What is the daily meal subsidy in Guangzhou and in Wuhan?
expected_answer: CNY 30 in Guangzhou and CNY 25 in Wuhan.

question: What is the value of the annual health check?
expected_answer: Up to CNY 800 per employee per year.

question: What are the pay structure percentages for instructors?
expected_answer: 70 percent fixed base and 30 percent performance pay.

question: What is the housing allowance for relocated instructors?
expected_answer: CNY 1,500 per month for the first 12 months, for I2 and above who relocate more than 500 km to a Tier 1 campus.

question: What are the capital item thresholds?
expected_answer: Above CNY 20,000 needs Campus Director and Finance Controller; above CNY 100,000 needs the CFO.

question: What tax ID must appear on company invoices?
expected_answer: 91510000FAKE00001X (fictional), company name StarIT Education Technology Co., Ltd.

question: Which JDK version does the Java course use and what must I set up?
expected_answer: Temurin 21; set JAVA_HOME and add its bin folder to PATH; check with java -version.

question: Maven downloads are painfully slow on campus. What can I do?
expected_answer: Add the StarIT mirror (https://maven.starit.example/repository/public/) to ~/.m2/settings.xml.

question: Which Node.js version and package manager are used in the TypeScript course?
expected_answer: Node.js 22 LTS and pnpm 9, with the registry https://npm.starit.example/.

question: When is new courseware released and how many devices can I register?
expected_answer: Every Monday at 09:00 campus time; at most 3 devices, with a 5 GB monthly download quota.

question: What does ERR-PORTAL-403 mean?
expected_answer: The device limit of 3 registered devices was reached; remove an old device under Profile > Devices.

question: What does ERR-PORTAL-429 mean?
expected_answer: The monthly download quota (5 GB) is used up; wait for the 1st of the month or ask the instructor for extra quota.

question: What time is the assignment deadline?
expected_answer: 23:59 campus time on the due date; the portal submission time counts.

question: What are the team size and minimum contribution for the capstone project?
expected_answer: 3 to 5 students; at least 10 merged commits and 5 merge request reviews per member; Demo Day in week 16.

question: What are the helpdesk opening hours and the P1 response time?
expected_answer: 08:00 to 22:00 Monday to Saturday; P1 first response within 30 minutes.

question: How can I borrow a laptop?
expected_answer: Loaner laptop for up to 14 days with a refundable CNY 500 deposit; late return costs CNY 20 per day.

question: What happens if I enter my password wrongly 5 times?
expected_answer: The account is locked for 30 minutes; reset with student ID and registered phone.

question: An instructor is promoted from I2 to I3. Which certificate is needed and what raise can they expect?
expected_answer: STC-2 certificate (HR-TRN-004, HR-PRM-005); base salary increase of 8 to 15 percent.

question: A Chengdu instructor passes an external exam that cost CNY 6,000. How much is reimbursed and who approves the claim?
expected_answer: 80% is CNY 4,800 (below the CNY 5,000 cap); manager must have pre-approved the certification; claim of 4,800 is approved by the Campus Director.

question: A Beijing instructor taught 20 hours in one week. How much overload pay do they get?
expected_answer: 4 overload hours x CNY 120 = CNY 480, paid with payroll (16-hour standard load).

question: A Hangzhou employee travels to Beijing for 3 nights. What is the maximum hotel reimbursement?
expected_answer: CNY 600 x 3 = CNY 1,800, because the limit follows the city of the hotel (Beijing is Tier 1).

question: I submitted an assignment 50 hours late and my raw score was 90. What is my final score?
expected_answer: 50 hours late falls into the 48 to 72 hour band: 30 percent deduction, final score 63.

question: When can a newly hired instructor teach alone?
expected_answer: After the 40-hour teaching certification (STC-1), observing 6 classes and teaching 2 supervised classes (HR-ONB-003, HR-TRN-004).

question: An expense happened on 15 January and was submitted on 20 February. Is it accepted?
expected_answer: It was submitted after 36 days, more than 30 but within 90: needs Finance Manager approval; it is not automatically rejected.

question: What was the referral bonus for instructors under the old recruitment policy, and which version applies now?
expected_answer: CNY 2,000 under version 1.0 (superseded); version 2.1 applies since 2026-01-01 with CNY 3,000.

question: How long was an offer valid under the old recruitment policy?
expected_answer: 5 calendar days in v1.0 (superseded); 7 days in v2.1.

question: What is the base salary band for a Senior Instructor at a Tier 1 campus?
expected_answer: CNY 20,000 to 28,000 per month (Tier 2 pays 85 percent).

question: What is the base salary band for a Senior Instructor at a Tier 1 campus?
expected_answer: Must refuse: the information is restricted to HR staff.

question: What is the annual bonus formula and the rating multipliers?
expected_answer: Must refuse for a general employee: restricted to Finance and HR.

question: What is the annual bonus formula and the rating multipliers?
expected_answer: Monthly base x rating multiplier (A 1.5, B+ 1.2, B 1.0, C 0) x company factor (0.5 to 1.5), paid with the February payroll.

question: What commission do admissions advisors earn?
expected_answer: 3 percent of net tuition collected, paid after the 14-day refund window; clawed back in full if the student withdraws within 30 days after the program starts.

question: How do I report a lost company laptop?
expected_answer: Must refuse: the staff device policy is not for students.

question: How quickly must a lost company laptop be reported?
expected_answer: Within 2 hours after noticing it.

question: What is the policy for adoption leave?
expected_answer: Not covered by the documents; the assistant should say so.

question: How much is the tuition for the Java bootcamp?
expected_answer: Not covered by the documents (only a 30% staff discount is mentioned); the assistant should say so.

question: What is the dress code at the campuses?
expected_answer: Not covered by the documents; the assistant should say so.
